scripts.gtfs:check-compatibility: uv run python scripts/check_gtfs_compatibility.py --feed-url https://production.gtfsrt.vbb.de/data --trips-file data/gtfs-static/GTFS/trips.txt --minimum-scheduled-match 0.99 --json
